spanish: Habla a Aarón, y dirás a él: En tu hacer subir las lámparas, hacia frente de faces de la menorá iluminarán las siete las lámparas.

findings.issue: Common noun (not a proper name) is left as the Hebrew loan menorá instead of a Spanish common noun.
The article is only on the lamps; the construct numeral has none. las siete las lámparas marks definiteness twice without a change of referent.

notes: Address, hiphil subir, plural faces, and 3mp iluminarán stay inside the tokens.
